headlines.text: Rewind to 2026, when it was title-change night for the AEW TNT Title as Tommaso Ciampa vs. Mark Briscoe battled it out, appearing on Collision, rated 8.18 ? one of the better matches of the year ? ending the champion's reign at 4 defenses. Tommaso Ciampa was challenging for gold for the very first time. Tommaso Ciampa made a stunning AEW in-ring debut, defeating Mark Briscoe in a match that went down to the final minute to become the new TNT Champion.
Looking back to 2024, when Swerve Strickland vs. Rob Van Dam settled things in a Hardcore match, headlining the show on Dynamite, rated 7.29 ? a good, competitive contest.
Looking back to 2026, when Dezmond Xavier laced up for their first AEW match, appearing on Collision, rated 5.83.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2026: Darby Allin vs. Clark Connors met for the very first time, setting the tone as the night's opener on Collision, rated 7.13 ? a strong outing.

It was 2026 when the AEW International Title was up for grabs as Kazuchika Okada vs. Adam Priest went to war, appearing on Collision, rated 6.20. For Adam Priest, it marked a first real shot at championship gold.
On this day in 2024, Jon Moxley vs. Jeff Hardy locked horns for the first time, getting things started right out of the gate on Dynamite, rated 6.28.
